tools.name: list_roles
tools.description: List every role in the ZeroCrew directory (customer support, sales, engineering, and more), the jobs inside each role, and how many live tools each has, with their zerocrew.ai pages. Use it to see what the directory covers, or to find the role and job slugs for search_tools and list_job.

tools.name: list_job
tools.description: List the tools for one job in the ZeroCrew directory, like role "support" and job "ai-receptionists", A to Z by default. ZeroCrew doesn't rank them.
